title: IACPaaS target IR universal JSON representation schema
description: JSON Schema for target information resources of IACPaaS platform, universal format

name.description: name of vertex (if it has ROOT or NONTERNIMAL or TERMINAL-SORT type

value.description: stringed representation of the vertex value

type.description: type of the vertex, one of 4 possible values - see 'enum'

valtype.description: type of the value of the vertex, one of 6 possible values - see 'enum'

meta.description: name of value of the meta vertex which corresponds to the current vertex

original.description: path to the original vertex within 'My fund' of the user and the information resource which holds that vertex; must have '$' as a delimiter between them and ';' at the end
examples: user@domain.com / Мой Фонд / База наблюдений$ / События;

link.description: path to the linked vertex within 'My fund' of the user and the information resource which holds that vertex; must have '$' as a delimiter between them and ';' at the end
examples: user@domain.com / Мой Фонд / База наблюдений$ / Наблюдения;
Программный инструмент для задания информационно-управляющих графов решателей задач

rcomment.description: comment for incoming relation from parent-concept to this concept
examples: Программный инструмент для задания информационно-управляющих графов решателей задач

successors.description: descr for direct successors of the vertex

title.description: name of information resource (same as name of root vertex)

code.description: could be a 64-bit unsigned integer but currently it's a String

path.description: path to information resource within 'My fund' of the user; must have '$;' at the end

date.description: date and time of recent changes; could be in date-time format but currently its a string

creation.description: date and time of resource creation; could be in date-time format but currently its a string

owner_id.description: id of the creator, used within the platform user database

ontology.description: path to information resource ontology within 'My fund' of the user or common fund; must have '$;' at the end
examples: user@domain.com / Мой Фонд / Структура базы знаний$;
